name: Storebælt and Øresund bridge tolls
law: Fixed price per crossing by vehicle length, on top of the km-based vejafgift: Storebælt (A/S Storebælt) and Øresund (Øresundsbro Konsortiet) price lists for 2026.

sources.title: Øresundsbron: prices for trucks and vans (business)

tolled_roads: The Storebælt bridge (E20 Funen-Zealand) and the Øresund bridge (E20 Copenhagen-Malmö).

closed_systems.name: Storebælt bridge
closed_systems.law: Storebæltsforbindelsen: prices set by the transport minister (lov om Sund & Bælt Holding A/S); A/S Storebælt's business price list 2026, DKK including 25% VAT, here excluding it. Green discount (Grøn rabat) 13% for EURO VI and electric or hydrogen trucks on a Storebælt Erhverv agreement paying automatically.

closed_systems.name: Øresund bridge
closed_systems.law: Øresundsbron: Øresundsbro Konsortiet's business prices per crossing, DKK excluding 25% VAT; with ØresundBUSINESS (etc) the price for the first 500 crossings a year by a truck over 9 m (580 DKK) or the first 1,000 by a van of 6-9 m (292 DKK).
